decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory closely tied to the installed trailer base, the protection cap remains a cheap option to keep open and supports the firm's service-oriented core business despite limited visibility.

A box car trailer series shown on the home page across two years looks like a strategically important core-market offer, so the firm would continue backing it rather than abandon a promising option in its main product family.

The car transporter trailer appears to be a more specialized and likely costlier niche option, and after two years without stronger prominence the firm would judge that enough has been learned to reallocate resources elsewhere.
A low-bed trailer series promoted on the home page fits the firm's established competencies and broad customer needs, making it worth retaining as a proven option in the core range.
The high trailer cover series is a complementary add-on with low ongoing carrying costs and clear fit with existing trailer lines, so keeping it preserves upside with limited downside.

Because this box car trailer series was also featured on the home page and aligns with the firm's main trailer business, management would likely keep it as part of a strong product family rather than narrow the range too early.
